about: Provenance of the vendored pstack-claude snapshot, checked by scripts/verify-curation.mjs. adopted: every path vendored from upstream (path is relative to skills/, upstream is relative to the upstream repository root; a different last segment is a rename). excluded: upstream skills deliberately not carried. modified: every vendored file that differs from upstream at the sha, with the reason. Rebuild the modified list on a re-sync by diffing each adopted path against upstream at the new sha. copies: files upstream ships twice, kept at both paths so the layout and links match upstream; each copy must stay identical to its original, so edit both together.
